accessibility: The source record is classified advanced; any adaptation still requires direct checks for semantics, focus, contrast, reflow, keyboard or touch behavior, and reduced motion.
brand_posture: A collaboration-oriented product system built from explicit foundations, an 8-pixel spacing base, semantic tokens, and reusable interaction patterns that must work across a large family of products.
color: Color should be tokenized by role and state. Brand color can be visible in navigation or primary emphasis, but status, selection, focus, and text roles must remain semantically stable.
components: Components should inherit shared tokens and preserve predictable behavior across dialogs, menus, tables, navigation, forms, and collaboration patterns. A local exception should be justified by a distinct job, not taste drift.
container: Use containers that keep 8-pixel spatial rhythm legible across the supported platforms.
failure_modes: Treating 8 pixels as a magic number while ignoring hierarchy.
Mixing local colors and radii that bypass semantic tokens.
Making each product area visually unique at the cost of recognizability.
Copying Atlassian blue or components without the underlying interaction grammar.
flows: Destination test: Collaboration software. Evaluate the relationship across creation and management.
forms: Use explicit labels, visible validation, and recovery that preserves entered work when forms are part of the adapted product.
grid: For Atlassian Design System, the grid must preserve the layout and density relationship described in the analysis rather than imitate source dimensions.
imagery: The recorded media strategy is none; no source imagery or visual assets are stored in the corpus.
interaction: Components should inherit shared tokens and preserve predictable behavior across dialogs, menus, tables, navigation, forms, and collaboration patterns. A local exception should be justified by a distinct job, not taste drift.
lane_fit: Lane assignment: Collaboration software. This case earns one SaaS, dashboard, administration, and productivity quota credit through 8-pixel spatial rhythm and semantic design tokens.
layout: Use a repeatable spacing rhythm and grid to support medium-to-high product density. Reserve large spacing jumps for real hierarchy. Avoid a card for every grouping when alignment and section structure already communicate relationships.
motion: Motion was not treated as a measured source token in the seed record; use it only for feedback, continuity, or hierarchy and mark further detail unknown.
navigation: Navigation should preserve location and the layout priority described for Atlassian Design System across the listed platforms.
responsive_behavior: Reorder by task and content priority while preserving 8-pixel spatial rhythm and semantic design tokens.
spacing: Spacing should preserve the case's medium density and make the documented hierarchy visible without adding decorative gaps.
states: Interactive states must keep the component roles in this case visible, including focus, selection, loading, error, and completion where applicable.
suitable_uses: systems that need a stable shared grammar across many teams
surfaces: Color should be tokenized by role and state. Brand color can be visible in navigation or primary emphasis, but status, selection, focus, and text roles must remain semantically stable.
typography: Typography should support rapid scanning in collaborative workflows. Separate page hierarchy, control labels, metadata, and long-form content. Do not use display treatments to make routine operational surfaces feel more branded.
unknowns: Internal metrics, unpublished design decisions, and source implementation details beyond the cited public guidance were not inspected.
unsuitable_uses: single-purpose brand sites where product-family consistency is not a constraint
designs that need irregular handcrafted spacing as a core expressive device
visual_thesis: Atlassian's transferable strength is product-family coherence. Foundations, tokens, and components create a grammar that can serve different collaboration products without every team inventing spacing, states, or interaction patterns again.
